name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
short_desc: The largest and most iconic royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty. Famous for the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony.

name: Gwanghwamun Square
short_desc: The central plaza featuring the iconic statues of King Sejong (creator of Hangul) and Admiral Yi Sun-sin.

name: Deoksugung Palace
short_desc: A unique palace blending traditional Korean and Western-style architecture.

name: Deoksugung Stone-wall Road
short_desc: A famous, romantic walking path wrapping around Deoksugung Palace.

name: Cheong Wa Dae (The Blue House)
short_desc: The former presidential residence located right behind Gyeongbokgung, now open to the public as a massive park.

name: National Palace Museum of Korea
short_desc: Located right on the Gyeongbokgung grounds, housing royal artifacts.

name: Bukchon Hanok Village
short_desc: A highly photogenic residential village filled with hundreds of preserved traditional Korean houses (hanoks).

name: Seochon Village
short_desc: A trendy, artistic neighborhood west of Gyeongbokgung known for hidden cafes, vintage shops, and older hanoks.

name: Insadong Culture Street
short_desc: The go-to pedestrian street for traditional Korean crafts, souvenirs, and traditional tea houses.

name: Jogyesa Temple
short_desc: The chief temple of Korean Buddhism, located just a short walk from Gwanghwamun, featuring beautiful lantern displays.

name: Tongin Traditional Market
short_desc: Famous for its 'Yeopjeon' (brass coin) lunchbox, where visitors buy ancient coins to trade for street food like oil tteokbokki.

name: Gwangjang Market
short_desc: Famous for its bustling street food alleys, specifically Bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes) and Yukhoe (beef tartare).

name: Tosokchon Samgyetang
short_desc: Legendary healthy Korean Chicken Soup with Ginseng, located in Seochon.

name: Jongno K-BBQ Alley
short_desc: A vibrant area for authentic Korean BBQ (Pork Galbi & Samgyeopsal).

name: Insadong Hanjeongsik
short_desc: A traditional Korean full-course dining experience featuring dozens of side dishes served in a hanok setting.

name: Cheonggyecheon Stream
short_desc: A peaceful, sunken urban stream running through downtown Seoul. Highly recommended for evening walks and lantern festivals.

name: Naksan Park
short_desc: Spectacular night views of the Seoul city walls and downtown skyline.

name: Lotte Department Store (Myeongdong Main)
short_desc: A massive shopping hub just south of the Gwanghwamun area, featuring a massive basement food hall.

name: Kyobo Bookstore (Gwanghwamun Branch)
short_desc: Korea's largest and most famous bookstore, located right at Gwanghwamun Square. A great cultural and stationary shopping spot.

name: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA)
short_desc: Located right next to Gyeongbokgung, offering world-class modern art exhibitions in a beautiful architectural space.
